## Decision requested

State the change that needs agreement.

## Current constraint

Point to the existing schema or instruction and describe the case it cannot handle.

## Evidence

Link a real audit, failing fixture, or reproducible validator result.

## Proposed change

## Alternatives considered

## Compatibility

List files, examples, or consumers that would need to change.
